do: no text, no logos, no watermarks

facts_bank: Many lifters target ~0.7–1.0g protein per lb of bodyweight per day.
Spreading protein across 3–5 meals can support muscle protein synthesis (MPS).
A common per-meal target is ~25–40g protein depending on body size and goals.
Leucine is a key amino acid linked with triggering MPS; high-quality proteins tend to be leucine-rich.
Protein also supports satiety—helpful in a calorie deficit.
Whole foods first; supplements are optional convenience.
Hydration and total calories matter—protein isn’t magic alone.
Consistency beats perfection: hit targets most days.
High-protein snacks can bridge gaps (Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, jerky, tuna, edamame).
Post-workout: protein + carbs can support recovery; daily totals matter most.
